轻松创建跨多种风格和情绪的令人惊叹的详细图像。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外— 在本地镜像之前在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用— 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则很有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配— 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时— 您希望完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望— 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

通过此工作流程，您可以探索针对不同视觉主题和艺术风格优化的专门模型变体集合。通过对细节和色调的精细控制，生成逼真的肖像、电影镜头或动漫风格的图像。该工作流程简化了微调模型的测试和比较，以实现高效的实验。优化的 UNet 加载器和 CFG 标准化的集成增强了视觉一致性。 LoRA 选项允许精确的风格混合。非常适合寻求可靠、高质量输出的艺术家和人工智能探索者。在多个经过微调的检查点中解锁一致、精美详细的视觉效果。

重要节点：

Comfyui Z-Image Finetuned Models 工作流程中的关键节点

  • 模型采样AuraFlow（＃76，＃84）

  • 目的：修补模型以使用与 AuraFlow 兼容的采样路径，该路径在非常低的步数下保持稳定。的转变控制巧妙地调整采样轨迹；将其视为与您的采样器选择和步骤预算相互作用的精细刻度盘。为了获得跨泳道的最佳可比性，请保留相同的采样器并仅调整一个变量（例如，转变或 LoRA 重量）每次测试。参考：AuraFlow 管道背景和调度说明。文档

  • CFG规范（#64、#65、#66、#67）

  • 目的：规范无分类器的指导，以便在更改模型、步骤或调度程序时对比度和细节不会剧烈波动。增加其实力泳道之间的高光是否褪色或纹理是否不一致；如果图像开始看起来过度压缩，请减少它。当您想要 Z 图像微调模型的干净 A/B 时，请保持跨分支的相似性。

  • LoraLoader仅模型（＃106）

  • 目的：将 LoRA 适配器直接注入到加载的 UNet 中，而不更改基本检查点。的实力参数控制风格影响；较低的值保留基本真实感，而较高的值则强加 LoRA 的外观。如果 LoRA 压倒了面孔或排版，请先减轻其重量，然后微调提示措辞。

  • KS采样器（#78、#85、#89、#93）

  • 目的：运行实际的扩散循环。选择与少步蒸馏完美搭配的采样器和调度器；对于 Turbo 级模型，许多用户更喜欢带有统一或多步调度程序的欧拉式采样器。比较泳道时保持种子固定，一次仅更改一个变量以了解每个微调的行为。

注释

ComfyUI 中的 Z-Image 微调模型 |多风格图像工作流程— 参见舒适运行页面了解最新的节点要求。

Create stunning, detailed images across multiple styles and moods easily.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning — you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises— run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout— useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON— the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense— you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations— First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

With this workflow, you can explore a collection of specialized model variations optimized for different visual themes and artistic styles. Generate realistic portraits, cinematic shots, or anime-inspired imagery with fine control over detail and tone. The workflow streamlines testing and comparison of finetuned models for efficient experimentation. Integration of optimized UNet loaders and CFG normalization enhances visual consistency. LoRA options allow precise style blending. Perfect for artists and AI explorers seeking reliable, high-quality outputs. Unlock consistent, beautifully detailed visuals across multiple finetuned checkpoints.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui Z-Image Finetuned Models workflow

  • ModelSamplingAuraFlow(#76, #84)

  • Purpose: patches the model to use an AuraFlow‑compatible sampling path that is stable at very low step counts. Theshiftcontrol subtly adjusts sampling trajectories; treat it as a finesse dial that interacts with your sampler choice and step budget. For best comparability across lanes, keep the same sampler and adjust only one variable (e.g.,shiftor LoRA weight) per test. Reference: AuraFlow pipeline background and scheduling notes.Docs

  • CFGNorm(#64, #65, #66, #67)

  • Purpose: normalizes classifier‑free guidance so contrast and detail do not swing wildly when you change models, steps, or schedulers. Increase itsstrengthif highlights wash out or textures feel inconsistent between lanes; reduce it if images start to look overly compressed. Keep it similar across branches when you want a clean A/B of Z-Image Finetuned Models.

  • LoraLoaderModelOnly(#106)

  • Purpose: injects a LoRA adapter directly into the loaded UNet without altering the base checkpoint. Thestrengthparameter controls stylistic impact; lower values preserve base realism while higher values impose the LoRA’s look. If a LoRA overpowers faces or typography, reduce its weight first, then fine‑tune prompt phrasing.

  • KSampler(#78, #85, #89, #93)

  • Purpose: runs the actual diffusion loop. Choose a sampler and scheduler that pair well with few‑step distillations; many users prefer Euler‑style samplers with uniform or multistep schedulers for Turbo‑class models. Keep seeds fixed when comparing lanes, and change only one variable at a time to understand how each finetune behaves.
